depth_semantics: DepthPerspective ray distance metres; raw floats retained; previews clamp 0..100 m only

rgb_depth_rpc_wall_s.meaning: RPC plus renderer/transport; excludes client file writes; A/B five views, C pooled mixture superseded by rgb_depth_rpc_by_view_count; not pure GPU render time

path_length_interpretation: sampled lower bound; contacts are sampled evidence
error_weighting: one equal weight per achieved state sample; purely geometric, no timed-reference alignment
tracking_error_caveat: reported polyline error is distance to dataset reference, not controller tracking error; learned requested paths are separate traces; resets break continuous physical path
